name: Jacqueline Abrams
description:
Jacqueline "Jacqui" Abrams — Professional Bio

Jacqui Abrams is the voice behind Run My AI Business and the Run My AI Biz newsletter on Substack, where she explores how artificial intelligence can help aspiring entrepreneurs create, launch, and manage online businesses. Her content focuses on making AI-powered business tools more approachable for first-time business owners, solopreneurs, and people who have ideas but feel overwhelmed by the technical work involved in bringing them to life.

Through her website and newsletter, Jacqui covers AI-assisted product creation, sales pages, lead magnets, sales funnels, email follow-up, scheduling, and ongoing business workflows. A central theme of her work is using conversational AI—giving instructions and feedback in everyday language—to coordinate business tasks while keeping the owner involved in reviewing and approving the results. She emphasizes an approach that reduces the need to move information between disconnected tools or learn coding before getting started.

Her weekly newsletter combines sourced AI tool comparisons, pricing breakdowns, explanations of AI’s development, step-by-step example businesses, and quick-start ideas. Her intended audience includes people starting their first online venture, professionals building a business on the side, and entrepreneurs who want AI to reduce their workload rather than add another layer of complexity.

Jacqui brings a personal, learning-by-doing perspective to this work. She describes having used ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google Gemini, but often feeling that receiving information was not the same as getting practical help completing a project. Her current focus grew from her experience using an AI bot to develop projects through conversation, review drafts, request changes, and move multiple ideas forward. She also acknowledges the hands-on work involved, including setting up connected accounts and reviewing content, images, video, and websites.

Alongside her publishing, Jacqui is an independent reseller of a separate AI business mastermind presented by three entrepreneurs. She discloses that she earns a commission when people join through her link and makes clear that she is not the program’s creator or one of its presenters. Her positioning is one of the first 50 that were allowed to become a part of this mastermind, and as a hands-on user, newsletter publisher, and independent reseller of the mastermind she is sharing her experience after learning from this mastermind—not an AI developer or a business coach claiming a documented record of client results but talks about the three successful businessmen behind this mastermind that have been earning millions of dollars online that are documented, with each maintaining multiple businesses now use this super AI she talks about to build new online businesses as well as run and manage their preexisting business, proving how what she calls this super AI will do everything for you, not just provide overwhelming information and then having you perform each step yourself.

Across her work, Jacqui’s message centers on helping people move from collecting information from AI and having to implement each step yourself, into taking practical action by having a certain super AI create and run their entire business from ideas to execution and then manage your online businesses from that point forward, with your approval each step of the way so it is not unleashed, but executes everything according to the plan you discussed. She presents AI as a tool for supporting that process while emphasizing human approval and acknowledging that income and business results are not guaranteed, although the speed at which you can create multiple businesses an entrepreneur can conclude that with the assistance of this super AI, you can establish, create and run and benefit from multiple streams of income.
